Name: Build Anywhere - Use Materials from Chests at Robin and Wizard
Author: ZeroXPatch
Description:
Thank you [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/NottAlexNumb]NottAlexNumb[/url] for the idea :3! 


[size=5][b][center]Build at Robin's and Wizard's with Materials from Home[/center][/b][/size][size=3]
[/size][center][size=3]Safe to uninstall anytime. Removing it just disables the features.

[/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements[/url][/size][/center]


Tired of trekking all the way to the Carpenter's Shop only to realize you left 50 wood in a chest back at the farm?

This mod allows you to construct farm buildings at Robin's (and the Wizard's) using materials stored in [b]any chest, fridge, or building[/b] on your save file. It turns your entire world into one giant inventory, saving you trips back and forth.

[size=4][b]Features
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Global Resource Access:[/b] Use wood, stone, and bars stored in Chests, Stone Chests, Big Chests, Fridges, Junimo Huts, and Auto-Grabbers.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Smart Consumption:[/b] The mod takes items from your backpack first. If you don't have enough on you, it automatically pulls the rest from your storage.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Works Everywhere:[/b] Compatible with Robin (Carpenter) and the Wizard (Obelisks/Junimo Huts).
[/list][list]
[*][b]Mod Compatible:[/b] Works with modded chests (provided they use standard Stardew logic) and Stardew Valley 1.6.
[/list]
[center]﻿[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41525/41525-1769031679-1593586345.gif[/img]﻿[/center]
[line]
[size=4][color=red][b]⚠️ Important: The "Red Text" Visual Quirk
[/b][/color][/size]
When you open the build menu, you may notice that the required materials (e.g., "Wood: 500") are displayed in [b][color=red]RED text[/color][/b], even if you have enough materials in your chests.
[b]This is purely cosmetic. The mod is working correctly!
[/b]
Here is how to tell if you can build:

[list]
[*]✅ [b]The Construct Button (Hammer) is lit up/clickable:[/b] You CAN build. The mod has found your materials.
[*]❌ [b]The Text is Red:[/b] Ignore this. It is a visual bug only.
[/list][b]Why didn't you fix the text color?
[/b]
The game handles the drawing of text colors deep within its rendering code (Graphics), separate from the logic that checks if you are allowed to build.
To turn the text green, I would have to perform complex "IL Patching" on the game's rendering engine. This is invasive and significantly increases the risk of breaking compatibility with other interface mods.

I chose to keep the mod [b]stable and compatible[/b] rather than risking crashes just to fix a font color. As long as the button works, you are good to go!

[center]﻿[youtube]I7Lew_kt7rQ[/youtube][/center]

[line]
[size=4][b]Installation
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder.
[*]Run the game!
[/list][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Requires Stardew Valley 1.6+.
[*]Works in Single Player.
[*]In Multiplayer, this mod usually needs to be installed by the player attempting to build.
[/list]
